VIJAY KUMAR A

Kumar.addhana@gmail.com| PH. 7989945987| Chittoor

PROFESSIONAL HEADLINE

Senior Associate |5+ Years| Fund Accounting | Investment Banking Operations | NAV Calculation | Corporate Actions | Private Equity | Financial Reconciliations

PROFILE SUMMARY

Having 5+ Years of experience in finance industry with fund accounting, Investment banking, financial

reporting, and financial management knowledge. • Around 5 Years of experience on NAV calculation. • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills • Experience on corporate action and its impact on stock price • Understanding of derivatives and options. • Experience in IPO analysis and FPO tracking • Collaborate with on-boarding team to provide web-based reporting to clients • Understand client relationships and expectations and ensure client deliverables are timely and accurate • Look to modify / iterate processes and procedures to continually improve accuracy, reduce redundanc • Working knowledge of SAP R3, Geneva, Investran, and SAP BW

WORK HISTORY

Feb 2021 – Till Date Senior Associate Cognizant- Bangalore

Part of EoN (NAVs to Nasdaq) Project Migration from Onshore. ● Make sure all the components of NAV are processed correctly before releasing NAV.

Verifying Top Movers securities and comparing with Client Valuation data if there is any discrepancy with prices applied by the pricing team and reaching out to pricing team for confirmation.

Manual pricing for underlying assets in internal application. ● Verifying feeds for different funds. ● Preparation of Net assets Review files. ● Verification of daily expenses calculation management fee, Custodian fee)

(Admin

Performs of Mergers of funds as per client requests ● Assist with month-end close process which includes clearing of Residual cost, fractional shares

Verifying Corporate Actions (Stock & Cash dividend, Bonus issue, Stock split, Reverse stock split, Mergers, Spinoff, Rights issues and Tender offer etc.) to avoid NAV errors.

Ensuring proper recording and supporting documentation of

portfolio investments

Record general ledger entries and investment activity to support

fund transaction activity

Prepare reconciliations to source documents of accounting data entered into the system. Research and clear reconciling items

Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual close for individual funds ● Prepares and reviews general ledgers, cash and valuation financial reconciliations, statements and footnotes.

investors'

capital  allocations,

Re Processing Dirty trades with clean price. ● Clearing critical Exceptions with proper investigation. ● Passing journal entries using SAP GLSU. ● Experience in cash and position reconciliations.

Reconciliation Knowledge and Responsibilities

Reconciliation of Corporate action checklists and TA positions. Investigating the Aged breaks outstanding and following ● escalation matrix.

Publishing data to management on daily, weekly, and monthly

basis.

Reconciliation of financial statements using SAP Bex and SAP R3 ● Researching private equity capital call notices. ● Verifying commitment and uncalled capital from notices. ● Capturing important data from LPAs. ● Preparing capital call checklist for GPs. ● Monitoring the fund’s cash flow activities and ensuring that payments are made on time

Monitoring the fund’s investments and capital activities in order

to ensure that they are booked correctly.

Book and review journal entries into accounting application ● Accounting for expenses,

including  management

fee,

performance fee, admin fee, Audit fee, interest rates, and taxes

with holding.

Cash bookkeeping and its implication within the business unit

and its basic functionality.

Posting journal entries in Investran by understanding the various journal entry types and how to correctly populate the segments in it.

EDUCATION

B. Com -2007 SV University- Tirupati

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Microsoft Office utilities (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). ● Accounting package - Tally. ● MCM ● SAP R3 ● SAP Bex ● Geneva ● SAP BW workbook ● Financial Modeling ● SQL, VBA
